report_empty_bullets.supporting_evidence: No supporting evidence has been classified yet.
report_empty_bullets.risks_and_contradictions: No risk or contradiction has been attached yet.
report_empty_bullets.invalidation: No explicit invalidation item has been attached yet.
report_empty_bullets.next_research: Wait for new information, then capture fresh evidence before changing the memo.

report_learning_notes.complete: The memo has a balanced base. Keep updating it only when you capture new evidence from the actual app surfaces.
report_learning_notes.incomplete_prefix: This memo is useful, but incomplete. The next step is:

quality.label: Excellent
quality.detail: Excellent quality can support conviction, but the entry and valuation still need confirmation.

quality.label: Strong
quality.detail: Strong quality gives the thesis fundamental support if valuation is still reasonable.

quality.label: Average
quality.detail: Average quality is workable, but the stock needs help from price action, valuation, or catalysts.

quality.label: Weak
quality.detail: Weak quality means the thesis needs clear confirmation before adding size.

quality.label: Fragile
quality.detail: Fragile quality means the thesis needs more than one bullish signal before it deserves conviction.

growth.label: Accelerating
growth.detail: Accelerating growth can justify a stronger upside case if margins and tape confirm.

growth.label: Healthy
growth.detail: Healthy growth supports a constructive thesis when valuation is not stretched.

growth.label: Steady
growth.detail: Steady growth is useful, but it rarely carries the thesis alone.

growth.label: Uneven
growth.detail: Uneven growth is not broken, but it needs confirmation from fresh financials or catalysts.

growth.label: Stalling
growth.detail: Stalling growth needs either a valuation gap, turnaround catalyst, or clear tape support.

risk.label: High
risk.detail: High risk needs tight invalidation and strong evidence before the position can be sized.

risk.label: Elevated
risk.detail: Elevated risk means the idea can work, but only with clear confirmation and controlled size.

risk.label: Moderate
risk.detail: Moderate risk demands confirmation, but it does not reject the idea by itself.

risk.label: Manageable
risk.detail: Manageable risk gives the thesis room to develop if evidence stays consistent.

risk.label: Low
risk.detail: Low risk gives the thesis more room, though price and valuation still matter.

stance.bullish: For a bullish stance, confirm that upside is supported by fresh buyers, not only a good story.
stance.bearish: For a bearish stance, look for evidence that weakness is company-specific and not just broad market fear.
stance.income: For an income stance, prioritize dividend coverage, payout durability, and cash-flow resilience.
stance.watch: For a watch stance, define the trigger that would move the idea from observation to action.

horizon.swing: For a swing horizon, focus on the next few sessions: price level, tape confirmation, and a near-term catalyst.
horizon.position: For a position horizon, check sizing against macro volatility, balance-sheet risk, and whether the thesis can survive several bad weeks.
horizon.income: For an income horizon, recheck payout coverage, cash generation, and whether rate moves change the yield tradeoff.
horizon.event: For an event horizon, pin the catalyst date, expected disclosure, and the stop if the market prices it early.
